changelog:
- Restored Authentic Fokk Brand Logo on startpage and menu sheet.
- Cleaned Navigation & Top Bar Icons: Removed incognito hat white border artifact, eliminated cyan glow on news icon, and perfected microphone visibility.
- Dark Obsidian Menu Bottom Sheet: Removed all blue/navy tints in favor of neutral dark charcoal, with solid black icons on crisp white badges for maximum clarity.
- Resilient Background & Screen-Off Audio Playback: Added explicit user pause tracking, webview timer guards, audio focus management, and service debounce so audio never cuts out when switching apps or locking phone.

- Add to Home Screen & Shortcuts: Pin any webpage directly to the Android launcher or Fokk Start speed dial.
